files.html:
0.2.8 Change Log

Added

  • Added double-click shortcuts for supported built-in editors.
  • Added hidden markers and persistent once-per-player triggers for Remnant Messages.
  • Added checkbox-based multi-selection, Select All, bulk deletion, and copy/paste support across supported editor lists.
  • Added trainer progress inspection and victory-count resets to Admin tools. Requires a compatible Cobble NPC addon on Fabric or NeoForge.
  • Added progress feedback for Admin batch operations.

Improved

  • Changed CustomNPCs from a required dependency to an optional dependency.
  • Relaxed version restrictions for optional integrations.
  • Reworked layouts, navigation, panel boundaries, and control placement across many editors.
  • Improved text wrapping, scrolling, overflow handling, and dropdown sizing.
  • Improved dialogue node, choice, condition, and action editing.
  • Improved quest hierarchy display, action configuration, target selection, and JSON pickers.
  • Improved item, image, sound, and color pickers, including filtering and parent-screen visibility.
  • Improved NPC Apply filters and Mods Config navigation.
  • Improved item lore formatting and Stat Builder previews on Forge and NeoForge.
  • Improved Korean terminology and corrected missing or unresolved UI translations.

Fixed

  • Fixed duplicate labels, clipped text, overlapping controls, and mismatched input bounds.
  • Fixed Forge crashes involving multiline input and dialogue node dragging.
  • Fixed Remnant Message editor crashes and once-per-player trigger behavior.
  • Fixed selection state being lost during editor updates.
  • Fixed tag toggle actions and several quest action configuration issues.
  • Fixed invisible dialogue load-list names and untranslated addon titles on Forge.

Performance

  • Reduced repeated GUI preview preparation and unnecessary component processing.
  • Improved caching for editor searches, NPC previews, and Admin lists.
  • Reduced redundant data transfers during Admin batch operations.
